title: dkim.key_seed_b64 not resolved through secretx:// at startup
description: main.rs resolves secretx:// URIs for bearer_token, nntp_password, and smtp_relay_peers[].password (lines 130-158), but dkim.key_seed_b64 is read directly from dcfg.key_seed_b64 without passing through resolve_secret_uri (line 184). The dkim.md operator guide explicitly states 'Use secretx:// URI injection ... for production deployments.' This means the documented workflow is broken: an operator who sets key_seed_b64 = 'secretx://...' will see a base64 decode error at startup instead of the secret being fetched. All other sensitive string fields have secretx resolution; this one does not.
